player_prompt.intro:
Ozali Moyambi {player_id} na mizungu {num_rounds} ya IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Na kila mizungu, kamba nambari kati ya {min_guess} na {max_guess}.
Simwa kamba zote mibale, elingi ezali (2/3)x(moyene ya kamba zote mibale),
na moyambi azali kamba akwami koleka elingi azwaka mizungu wana.
Yembisa na kamba yako na muundo '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Formate ya malamu te; na sengi kopesa likanisi lokola [<number>].

message.round_guesses: Moyambi 0 akamba {guess0}; Moyambi 1 akamba {guess1}. Kwa hiyo Eligi ezali: {target}.
message.round_draw: Lisano ya mibale ezali na nsuka te.

outcome.p1_wins: Mosani ya liboso alongaki masano mingi.
outcome.draw: Na mobimba, lisano yango ezali na molɔngɔ te.
